newsitem.title: TURKEY: Nine Turks in custody for anti-Israel protest.
newsitem.headline: Nine Turks in custody for anti-Israel protest.

text.p: Nine Turks were being held in police custody on Thursday after an Islamist demonstration against Israel at Ankara's biggest mosque last week, a state security court official said.
"They are still at police headquarters and the inquiry is continuing," he told Reuters.
The nine were among 15 suspects originally detained in the days following two separate protests in the capital after noon prayers last Friday.

Demonstrators, including dozens of people at the main Kocatepe mosque, chanted Islamist slogans and burned Israeli flags to protest at the killing of Palestinians in gun battles with Israeli soldiers last month.

Turkish television had shown pictures of the protesters waving flags of the Welfare Party of Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, who has backtracked on promises to scrap a military training accord signed with Israel before he took office in June.
